title: A Cheap Antidepressant May Ease Long COVID's Crushing Fatigue
hook: In a trial of nearly 400 adults, the low-cost antidepressant fluvoxamine significantly reduced long COVID fatigue and improved quality of life — one of the first medications shown to help.
key_points: Long COVID fatigue has had few proven treatments, leaving many people with persistent, disabling exhaustion.
In a randomized clinical trial of 399 adults, the antidepressant fluvoxamine significantly reduced fatigue compared with placebo.
Participants taking fluvoxamine also reported improved quality of life.
Fluvoxamine is one of the first medications to show meaningful benefit for long COVID fatigue specifically.
content_html: Long COVID fatigue has been one of the condition's most stubborn symptoms, with few treatments showing clear benefit. A randomized trial now points to an unexpected option: a decades-old, inexpensive antidepressant.
extra_html: As ScienceDaily reports, the trial involved 399 adults, and those who took fluvoxamine saw significantly reduced fatigue and better quality of life compared with those on placebo. Fluvoxamine is already approved and cheap, which matters for a condition that's disproportionately hit people without easy access to specialized long COVID care. It's one of the first medications to show meaningful benefit for this specific symptom — not a cure for long COVID broadly, but a genuine, low-cost option for a symptom that's had almost none.
